hold_text: Adds a Tier-1 read-only action (disk-usage-report) and a Tier-2 deleting action (prune-db-backups, dry-run default) to the system-actions allowlist. Lane policy: landing: hold; the manager merges.
why: Live VM root disk at 96% (2.4 G free) with a 2.09 GB journal: one more full-journal backup could fill the disk under the live trader. No allowlisted action could explain usage or prune the unretained <db>.bak-* copies.
